    Target Management
    Executive & team monthly targets, with automatic weekly distribution.
    Shared Target Storage
    Monthly Targets (executive roster, monthly & weekly targets) are shared across every user/system via this endpoint — not stored in this browser's LocalStorage. Point it at a Google Apps Script Web App (recommended), Firebase Realtime Database REST URL, Supabase table, or any endpoint reachable by all users that returns/accepts JSON like {"execs":[...],"overrides":[...]}.
    LOCAL ONLY
    Free option using Google Apps Script (works well since you already use Google Sheets):
    1. Create a Google Sheet with two tabs: Execs (Name, Team, Source, MonthlyTarget, RevenueTarget, LeadTarget, PaymentTarget, DateCreated, DateModified, CreatedBy, LastUpdatedTimestamp) and Overrides (Month, CRE, SalesTarget, RevenueTarget, LeadTarget, PaymentTarget, WeeklyTargets, DateCreated, DateModified, CreatedBy).
    2. Extensions → Apps Script → paste a script that: on GET, returns {execs:[...], overrides:[...]} read from both tabs; on POST, handles action = saveExecs (overwrite the Execs tab, stamping DateCreated/DateModified/CreatedBy), saveOverride, and deleteOverride.
    3. Deploy → New deployment → Web app → "Anyone" can access → copy the deployment URL.
    4. Paste that URL above and click Connect. Every user of this dashboard who has the same URL configured will now see the same Monthly Targets, synced automatically every ~20s — no more re-entering targets per device.
    Shared Photo Storage
    CRE profile photos (Insights → Top Performers only) are shared across everyone via this endpoint — not stored in this browser. Point it at a Google Apps Script Web App, Firebase Realtime Database REST URL, Supabase table, S3+Lambda, or any endpoint reachable by all users that returns/accepts JSON like {"Name":"https://…/photo.jpg"}.
    LOCAL ONLY
    Free option using Google Apps Script (works well since you already use Google Sheets):
    1. Create a Google Sheet with two columns: Name, PhotoUrl.
    2. Extensions → Apps Script → paste a script that: on GET, reads the sheet and returns it as JSON; on POST, upserts the row for the given name and set/clears PhotoUrl.
    3. Deploy → New deployment → Web app → "Anyone" can access → copy the deployment URL.
    4. Paste that URL above and click Connect. Every user of this dashboard who has the same URL configured will now see the same photos, synced automatically every ~20s.

      Firebase Database — Overall Dashboard
      Firestore can act as the shared cloud database for operational dashboard data such as Tickets, Updates, Notifications, User metadata, Targets, Settings, and dashboard sync metadata. The existing Google Sheets remains the live analytical source and IndexedDB remains the large local cache. Paste the Firebase Web App config from Firebase Console to enable it.
      LOCAL FALLBACK
      Security note: the Firebase Web App config is client configuration, not a service-account private key. Protect Firestore data with Firebase Authentication and Firestore Security Rules.
      User Management
      Client-side demo directory, stored hashed in this browser. Connect a real backend/auth provider for production use.
      Users Directory (Shared Google Sheet)
      All Add, Edit, Delete, Activate/Deactivate, and Role Change operations sync to this shared endpoint so every device sees the same user directory. Point it at a Google Apps Script Web App bound to a Sheet with columns: Full Name, Username, Email, Password (Encrypted), Role, Status, Department, Designation, Created Date, Last Login, Last Updated.
      LOCAL ONLY
      Without a connected endpoint, the directory is kept in this browser only (LOCAL ONLY), so it still works before setup.
      Email Delivery (OTP)
      OTP codes go to any user in the Users Directory — every user becomes eligible for Login OTP, Forgot Password, and Forgot Username the moment an Admin adds them and sets them Active, using the email stored in that record. There is no separate allowlist to maintain. Login OTP, Forgot Password, Forgot Username, and New User Verification codes are never shown on screen or logged to the console. Point this at a real email endpoint (SMTP relay, SendGrid, Mailgun, Amazon SES, Firebase Function, or a Google Apps Script using MailApp) that accepts {"to","subject","code"} and actually sends the email.
      NOT CONFIGURED
      Without a connected endpoint, no email is sent and the person is told to contact an administrator — the code is intentionally never revealed in the UI, matching the "never display the OTP" requirement.

      Executive-grade sales command center wired directly to Google Sheets. All computations run in your browser — nothing is uploaded to a server.

      Recent Updates
      Frequently Asked
      How often does data refresh?
      Choose between 5s / 10s / 30s / 1m / 5m / Manual from the header dropdown. Default is 30 seconds.
      What if Google Sheets is unreachable?
      The dashboard automatically falls back to the last cached snapshot stored in your browser, and shows a notification when connection resumes.
      Can I use my own sheet?
      Yes — go to Upload → Connect Google Sheet and paste any published-to-web CSV URL, or set it once from Settings → Google Sheet connection.
      How is "Conversion Rate" calculated?
      Two different formulas, depending on where you're looking: on the Dashboard, it's (Won leads ÷ Total leads) × 100 — a lead counts as Won when its payment status is Paid. On the Sales vs Target table, "Conversion (%)" is (Revenue Achieved ÷ Sales Target) × 100 instead, since that page measures progress toward a target rather than lead-to-sale conversion.
      Where are my uploaded files stored?
      In your browser's LocalStorage only — never uploaded to any server. They stay on this device and are managed from Saved Files.
      What can each User Management role do?
      Admin has full access to every module and can manage users. Manager can view everything and edit Target Management/Sales Targets, but can't access User Management, Upload, or Saved Files. Read Only can view, filter, and search everywhere, but can't edit anything, and Target Management is hidden entirely.
      Why can't a newly added user log in right away?
      New accounts require OTP verification — a 6-digit code is emailed to them on creation, and they must enter it on first login before access is granted. If Email Delivery isn't connected yet, an Admin can use Manually Verify from User Management instead.
      Who can see a user's password?
      Only Admins, via the eye icon in the Users table's Password column. Passwords are stored encrypted (not as plaintext), and Manager/Read Only accounts never see the reveal option at all.
      What's the difference between the Month Selector and the Calendar Filter?
      The Month Selector (top of the Dashboard) is a single-month toggle that scopes Dashboard, Analytics, Sales vs Target, Data Table, and Comparison together, defaulting to the current month. The Calendar Filter is a separate, independent date-range filter lower in the filter bar — the two don't affect each other.
      What do Premium & Elite Plan, Refund Dashboard, and Marketing show?
      Three fully independent modules in the sidebar, each with its own CSV connection, filters, KPIs, charts, and data table — none of them share data with the Main Dashboard or with each other. Each has its own "Connect CSV Link" section at the top of its page.
      What's "Target Required for 80%" in Sales vs Target?
      How much more revenue a CRE needs to reach 80% of their assigned Sales Target: MAX((Sales Target × 0.80) − Revenue Achieved, 0). It shows ₹0 once 80% has already been reached or passed.
      What is the Course-wise Lead Source Performance Matrix?
      A table at the bottom of the Dashboard showing Leads, Payments, Revenue, and Conversion Rate for every course, broken down across each payment/lead source (CPC, Meta, Direct, WhatsApp, etc.), with a Grand Total row. It respects all active filters, the same as every other Dashboard KPI.
      Who can see entries in the Updates page?
      Everyone sees feature/fix updates marked "All Users." User Management and account-security actions (new user, role changes, password resets, activations) are logged automatically and restricted to Admin visibility only.
      How does Comparison 1 / Comparison 2 work?
      Comparison 1 is the primary period shown across KPIs, charts, and the table; Comparison 2 is optional and adds a trend/percentage-change comparison against a second period. Available on the Comparison page and inside Premium, Refund, and Marketing's own filter bars.
